'''IsoTech''' was a front company owned by [[Reom]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], to cover his operations with the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. It was founded by Reom's father, [[Ropok]], and was located on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="BTR">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>
